column1: # Where AI coding agents keep their session transcripts. One line each, tab separated.
#   os      all, mac, linux or win (win is Git Bash and gird-check.ps1)
#   kind    read; db for a folder whose SQLite files (*.db and their *.db-wal) are read and nothing
#           else in it; or sealed for a folder whose .pb files are stored encrypted, by third-party
#           accounts (counted and named as not checked)
#   path    a file or a folder. ~ is the home folder, {AS} the app data folder (Application Support
#           on a Mac, ~/.config on Linux, %APPDATA% on Windows; VS Code and other Electron apps
#           move it to XDG_CONFIG_HOME on Linux, so their folders get a linux line with it too),
#           state folders: under GOOSE_PATH_ROOT when it is set, else the XDG folders, or
#           %APPDATA%/Block/goose/data for both on Windows), and {ENV:NAME:fallback} an
#   source  how the location was established: measured, source code, docs or third party
